limitations: Identity-shape validation is not authentication; a service can deliberately imitate a valid bridge response.
Explicit port routing bypasses selection discovery for that call. Ports may change owners after validation.
Pathless legacy identity matching relies on project names and cannot distinguish identical names.
Fresh-registry recovery for unavailable or non-successful HTTP responses preserves existing behavior but cannot prove current endpoint ownership.
Live checks use Windows and Unity 6000.6.2f1; older Unity runtime remains deferred.
